papers.title: Probabilistic Modeling of Fatigue Life Prediction of Notched Specimens Combining Highly Stressed Volume and Theory of Critical Distance Approach
papers.abstract: Notch and size effects significantly influence the fatigue performance of engineering components, which is crucial for ensuring structural integrity. A novel probabilistic fatigue life prediction Kt-V-L model considering both the size and the notch effect, based on the theory of critical distance L (TCD) and the improved highly stressed volume V (HSV) method, is proposed in this study. The new definition more accurately characterizes fatigue damage and accumulation, overcoming the underestimation issues of traditional HSV methods under high-stress or low cycle fatigue (LCF) conditions. Specifically, the Weibull distribution is also proposed to characterize the material fatigue failure probability. The experimental data of 26Cr2Ni4MoV, En3B, and TC4 materials with varying notched sizes are utilized for the model validation and comparison. In addition, the predictive ability of the point method (Kt-V-L-PM) and line method (Kt-V-L-LM) under the novel proposed model was explored and evaluated. The predicted lives of 26Cr2Ni4MoV specimens fall within the ±2 scatter band of the Kt-V-L-LM, while the Kt-V-L-PM shows increasing deviation with larger notches due to its limited ability to capture stress gradients. For En3B and TC4, the predicted lives are within ± 2 life factors, verifying the model’s reliability and accuracy. Furthermore, fracture morphology analysis reveals the influence of notches on fatigue performance and elucidates the fracture failure mechanisms.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文虽涉及TC4材料，但研究对象为传统制造工艺下的缺口试样疲劳寿命，未涉及增材制造Ti-6Al-4V的力学或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V; it studies conventionally processed materials and does not consider AM-specific features such as porosity, residual stress, surface roughness, or build orientation.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对传统缺口试样疲劳寿命预测中尺寸与缺口效应的影响，提出概率模型。
summary_zh.method: 基于临界距离理论和高应力体积法，引入Weibull分布表征失效概率。
summary_zh.result: 模型对26Cr2Ni4MoV、En3B和TC4的预测寿命均在±2倍分散带内，验证了准确性。
summary_zh.validation: 使用三种材料的缺口疲劳实验数据验证模型。

summary_en.motivation: To address the combined notch and size effects on fatigue life, a probabilistic model is proposed for notched specimens.
summary_en.method: A novel Kt-V-L model is developed by integrating the theory of critical distance (TCD) with an improved highly stressed volume (HSV) method, and a Weibull distribution characterizes the failure probability.
summary_en.result: The predicted fatigue lives for 26Cr2Ni4MoV, En3B, and TC4 fall within a ±2 scatter band, confirming the model's reliability.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated using experimental fatigue data of notched specimens made from three different materials, including TC4.

papers.title: Silver multilayer coating on orthopedic implant material of different alloys and surfaces significantly reduces bacterial colonization
papers.abstract: Introduction Prosthetic joint infections (PJI) affect 1-3% of prosthetic joint replacements, frequently linked to biofilm formation on implant surfaces. PJIs account for 13.0-31.3% of all revision surgeries. As treatment is not always successful, prevention remains critical. Currently, silver based antimicrobial coatings are justified in select high-risk arthroplasty cases, restricted to metal surfaces. An antibacterial silver multilayer coating (SML) has been developed for implant materials: titanium alloy (Ti) and cobalt-chromium-molybdenum alloy (CoCr), often used in hip or knee prostheses. The SML coating is intended for revision implants, which are often required due to infection related implant failure. This study investigates the antibacterial performance of the SML coating across different surfaces and implant materials, using multiple bacterial strains not previously investigated to this extent. Methods Antibacterial efficacy of the SML coating was assessed by quantifying colony forming units (CFU) reduction on Ti6Al4V and Co28Cr6M discs with three different surfaces (polished and two grades of corundum blasted (CB)). In vitro standardized testing followed ISO 22196, JIS Z-2801, and ASTM E-2180 standards using American Type Culture Collection (ATCC) strains Pseudomonas aeruginosa ATCC15442, Staphylococcus aureus ATCC6538p, Staphylococcus epidermidis ATCC35984, Pseudomonas aeruginosa ATCC15442, and Escherichia coli ATCC8739. Two groups were tested: non-SML-coated samples and SML-coated samples. After 24 hours incubation in viscous nutrient broth at 37°C, viable bacteria were quantified per disc after sonication in neutralizing broth and CFU enumeration. Results Across all materials and strains, the SML coating achieved &gt;99.2% and &gt;0.9-4.0 CFU log 10 reduction in viable bacteria compared to the non-SML-coated controls. Material-dependent effects were observed for each of the bacterial species analyzed. S. aureus and E. coli exhibited more CFUs on Ti than on CoCr. The CoCr CB surface yielded the lowest level of bacterial growth for P. aeruginosa ATCC15442, whereas S. epidermidis colonized the Ti CB surface more extensively. Discussion and conclusion These findings demonstrate a thorough and broad-spectrum antibacterial activity of the SML coating across diverse implant materials and surface textures. Future studies will focus on testing clinical PJI isolates in both in vitro and in vivo models to further evaluate the translational potential of the SML coating for prevention of bacterial colonization in joint arthroplasty.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是钛合金和钴铬合金上的银涂层抗菌性能，不涉及股骨柄的结构设计或力学性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on antibacterial coating and bacterial colonization reduction, with no content on femoral stem structural design, lattice architecture, stress shielding, or mechanical testing of Ti-6Al-4V implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少假体周围感染导致的翻修手术
summary_zh.method: 在钛合金和钴铬合金表面制备银多层涂层，测试多种细菌的菌落减少
summary_zh.result: 涂层使细菌减少>99.2%，但效果与材料和表面有关
summary_zh.validation: 按照ISO 22196等标准进行体外抗菌测试

summary_en.motivation: To reduce prosthetic joint infections that often lead to revision surgeries, an antibacterial silver coating is evaluated.
summary_en.method: Silver multilayer coating was applied on Ti6Al4V and Co28Cr6Mo discs with different surface finishes, and antibacterial efficacy was tested against multiple bacterial strains.
summary_en.result: The coating achieved >99.2% reduction in viable bacteria across all materials and strains, with material-dependent variations.
summary_en.validation: In vitro standardized testing followed ISO 22196, JIS Z-2801, and ASTM E-2180 using ATCC bacterial strains.
